argument: The archive must be carried by a changed arrival cadence in the agents, not by the coral debt rings or the GPU label. Hide both witnesses and ask whether the bands still shear.
A caption-free viewer should find one unmistakable staggered arrival band after the first debt; if the field only reads as a glowing mesh, the timing rule is not visible.
Capturing at two different points should create different downstream arrival signatures, while lifting the latest debt must return the exact prior agent field.
Latency is an attractive metaphor. Delete v002 if the short timing threads read as decorative rays, if a debt only changes colour, or if the crowd still arrives as one body without the counters.
